proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_spawned_creature.catalog_ref_stat_block
proposed_widenings.justification: The item already fits the existing magic-item spawned-creature activation shape, but it summons a named existing monster rather than an inline item-specific stat block. The current surface can only encode magic-item summons with an inline CreatureStatBlock, which would force duplication or a placeholder and would not honestly model the item as written.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental"

notes: The rest of the item fits existing surface concepts: magic-item activation, Magic action cost, 30-foot placement, commanded companion, immediate-after-you turn order, 1-hour duration, Bonus Action dismissal, and dawn reset. The blocker is the missing catalog-reference summon variant for magic-item spawned creatures.
